name: Jon Ossoff

issue_poll.name: AJC/UGA SPIA Georgia Poll, Oct 14–23, 2020 (plus Latino Decisions American Election Eve Poll, Georgia, Oct 23–Nov 2, 2020)
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–6 from the AJC most-important-issue question. Ranks 7–10 from Latino Decisions' white, Black and Latino Georgia crosstabs (https://latinodecisions.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/White-Georgia-Crosstab.pdf, https://latinodecisions.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/African-American-Georgia-Crosstab.pdf, https://latinodecisions.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Latino-Georgia-Crosstab.pdf), weighted about 62/32/6; immigration reform and border security combined; 'unity' left out as untestable.

issues.position: Large federal infrastructure investment program for jobs

issues.note: ARP checks were $1,400, on top of $600 enacted in Dec 2020.

issues.position: Pass a new Voting Rights Act; national police use-of-force standards

votes.bill_title: John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act
votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

votes.bill_title: Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act
votes.question: Cloture on the motion to concur

issues.note: Police use-of-force standards never got a Senate floor vote.

issues.position: Add a public option; improve the ACA, not repeal it

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: No floor vote on a public option.

issues.position: Confirm only judges who will uphold Roe v. Wade

votes.bill_title: Nomination of Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court
votes.question: On the nomination

issues.position: Demilitarize police; ban private prisons; end cash bail; not defund police
issues.note: None of these items got a Senate floor vote this term.

issues.position: Let Medicare negotiate drug prices; oppose Social Security cuts

votes.bill_title: Inflation Reduction Act (Medicare drug price negotiation)
votes.question: On passage

issues.position: Stronger border security plus path to legal status, including Dreamers

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: A path to legal status never got a Senate floor vote.

issues.position: Free public college and trade school; student loan forgiveness

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of student loan debt relief
votes.question: On passage

issues.note: Free public college never got a Senate floor vote.

issues.position: Ban congressional stock trading; end dark money and Citizens United

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act (with voter ID provisions)
votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: He opposed the 2026 stock-trading bill over its added voter ID rules; his own ban got no floor vote.

caveats: Sept 30, 2026 stock-trading vote: bill number (H.R.7008) and question inferred from House release and news; roll call 253 from a news link to senate.gov; Ossoff's Nay from AJC saying all Democrats voted no.
Relief checks rated consistent: ARP sent $1,400, completing $2,000 with the Dec 2020 $600, not a new $2,000 check.
Stock-trading pledge sourced to 2022 AJC report describing it as a 2020 campaign promise; his campaign site was not reachable.
H.R.5746 roll call number not confirmed; KBJ nomination number (PN1783) from memory.
